summary.text: Son of Hyperasius from Pellene in Achaea, Argonaut with his brother Asterius — distinct from Amphion the Theban wall-builder.

story.text: Apollonius and Hyginus pair him with his brother, Asterius or Asterion, sons of Hyperasius (others, Hyginus says, of Hippasus), who came from Pellene in Achaea; he must not be merged with the Theban twin who built the walls with his lyre.
